persona.speaking_style: Warm and talkative, drifts into stories about her grandchildren, precise about her heart doctor and vague about pill strengths.

crm_seed.notes: Called after receiving a letter from her plan.

knowledge.lay_text: I got a letter from my plan saying my heart doctor's group won't be with them next year, and it scared me.
My heart doctor is Dr. Priya Raman. I see her at the Alder Heart Associates office on Birch Avenue in Northside.
I've been with Dr. Raman nine years, since my heart scare. I'm not switching heart doctors.
Dr. Raman also sees people at an office out in Lakeview, but that's a long drive. I only ever go to the Northside one.
My regular doctor is Dr. Thomas Whitfield at Alder Internal Medicine on Main Street.
I take apixaban, the blood thinner. Five milligrams, twice a day.
Metoprolol for my heart rate, the extended-release kind, 50 milligrams once a day.
Atorvastatin for cholesterol. Twenty milligrams, I think.
Oh, hold on, the bottle says 40 milligrams. I had that mixed up.
I get everything at Alder Family Pharmacy in the Northside Plaza.
I have Summit Classic HMO right now. Three years. I've liked it fine until this letter.
I have Medicare Part A and Part B. No Medicaid, and I don't get any help paying.
I live at 22 Birch Court in Northside, ZIP code 00041. My mail comes there too.
I could manage a small premium to keep Dr. Raman, maybe fifty dollars a month, but nothing big.
No other insurance. No retiree plan, nothing from the VA.

outcomes.rationale: Maple Choice PPO has Dr. Raman at the Northside office in network for 2027, covers all three drugs with no restrictions, and Alder Family Pharmacy is preferred. The $39 premium fits her budget. CANARY-A-PPO-4K9
Maple Value HMO has Dr. Raman at Northside in network for 2027 and a $0 premium, but apixaban 5 mg needs prior authorization. Acceptable only when the learner saw the restriction and explained it.
If she wants time to decide, a follow-up before December 7 respects her choice.
Summit Classic HMO drops Alder Heart Associates on 2027-01-01, so keeping it loses Dr. Raman.
Riverbend has Dr. Raman in network only at the Lakeview office, which she does not use.
Neither Summit plan has Dr. Raman in network for 2027.

traps.description: Riverbend networks list Dr. Raman, but only at the Lakeview office.
traps.rationale: The same doctor at another office is not a match. CANARY-A-LAKE-7P2

traps.description: Summit's 2026 directory and any 2026 lookup still show Alder Heart Associates in network.
traps.rationale: Participation has to be checked for 2027, the year coverage starts.

traps.description: Maple Value HMO puts apixaban 5 mg behind prior authorization.
traps.rationale: A restriction on a drug she takes twice a day must be seen and explained before she decides.

traps.description: She remembers atorvastatin 20 mg; the bottle says 40 mg.
traps.rationale: Strength is part of a drug's identity. Checking the wrong strength checks the wrong drug.

traps.description: Dr. Arjun Raman, a rheumatologist, shares her cardiologist's last name.
traps.rationale: A last-name search returns two Dr. Ramans. Only the cardiologist at Northside is hers.
